answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
